changelog: [Decision Procedure]: added new step 1b establishing that the generic clause-completeness test (steps 3-6) takes precedence over the surface-form bans on -는데/-고/-아서·어서/니까 whenever A already states a full independent proposition AND B opens its own independent subject+predicate — instructs the model to segment at the connective even with no following discourse marker/reporting verb, directly targeting the critic's flagged under-segmentation of long multi-clause utterances that were being left whole solely because they contained a continuation-marker surface form.

[Examples — Segment]: replaced two redundant discourse-marker-triggered examples with two new generic examples illustrating a split at a contrastive '-는데' connective and a causal '-아서' connective where both resulting clauses are independently complete, reinforcing the new step 1b rule with concrete, non-dataset-specific patterns; count stays at 12.
